title: Cultivation Assessment & Water System Recovery
subtitle: Restoring the Outpost Water Supply and Verifying the Cultivation Experiment
description: Investigate the water-system condition following the SOL 7 dust storm, restore the main water supply where required, inspect the two cultivation racks, verify irrigation and nutrient distribution, and review the cultivation experiment initiated during SOL 6.

prerequisites.description: SOL 6 cultivation experiment records and soil sample provenance must remain accessible.
SOL 7 storm event records, timestamps and post-storm assessment must be preserved.

missionZones.purpose: Inspect the available water and nutrient reserve information through the existing Habitat interface.
Inspect the two cultivation racks through their existing connected physical display and OS application.
Inspect and restore the main water supply through the existing Board and Supply interface.
Review mission status and submit the final SOL 9 report through the existing supported interface.

researchCultivationDisplay.description: Existing Research Zone Cultivation Environment display; the GLB does not provide named cultivation-rack objects or a verified rack-to-chamber data binding.

engineeringWaterSupplyDisplay.description: Existing Engineering Life Support Resource display; the requested Board and Supply display was not present in the inspected model.

habitatWaterDisplay.description: Existing Habitat water and nutrients status interface.

SOL09_CULTIVATION_MANAGEMENT.description: An existing-display OS application for reviewing Sol 6 history and separate Rack 01/Rack 02 records. Rack-specific physical and telemetry mappings remain explicitly unavailable where not present in source data.

sections.title: Cultivation Overview
sections.description: Display a combined summary of both racks without merging their individual records.

sections.title: Cultivation Racks
sections.description: Allow the player to select either of the two existing cultivation racks.

sections.title: Experiment History
sections.description: Review the cultivation experiment initiated in SOL 6.

sections.title: Plant Condition
sections.description: Show the latest persisted observations for the selected rack.

sections.title: Irrigation Status
sections.description: Inspect water availability and irrigation delivery for the selected rack.

interactiveControls.description: Enable or disable the existing irrigation control if supported by the current system.
Run a supported irrigation status test and display the returned result.

sections.title: Nutrient Supply
sections.description: Inspect nutrient availability and distribution for the selected rack.

sections.title: Root Environment
sections.description: Show only environmental values that are already recorded or supported by the current cultivation simulation.

sections.title: Automation
sections.description: Inspect the existing irrigation automation and scheduling state.

sections.title: Observation History
sections.description: Review the selected rack's persisted history without combining it with the other rack.

irrigationDistribution.description: Display a technical visualization of the existing irrigation distribution path serving the selected rack.
rules: Do not invent physical pipes or valves that do not exist in the project.
Do not allow a visual diagram interaction to bypass mission validation.
Do not claim that water physically flowed unless the relevant system state confirms it.
Keep Rack 01 and Rack 02 distribution states independent.

nutrientMonitoring.description: Provide an interactive representation of nutrient availability, mixing status and delivery to the selected rack.
scientificRules: Use existing experiment configuration for valid ranges.
Do not create arbitrary pH or EC target values.
If no valid target range exists, provide inspection only and mark calibration unavailable.

validationRules: A rack must be inspected individually.
A rack test must use its own persisted state.
A successful test on Rack 01 must not complete Rack 02.
A failed test must remain failed or unresolved until a valid retry succeeds.
A UI toggle alone must not complete a mission objective.
Only a validated system result can publish a completion event.

SOL09_WATER_SUPPLY_CONTROL.description: An assessment application on the existing Engineering Life Support Resource display. The requested Board and Supply display, main-supply status and physical repair control were not found, so the application does not claim a water repair.

statusRules: Do not assume the water supply is damaged before inspection.
Do not fabricate reserve percentages or pressure values.

sections.title: Filtration & Pumping
sections.description: Show only components confirmed to exist in the current Engineering Unit model and project configuration.

sections.title: Post-Storm Assessment
sections.description: Review SOL 7 storm records and correlate them with actual water-system records.

interactiveWaterDiagnosis.description: Provide an interactive technical diagram representing the actual existing water supply and distribution topology.
validationRules: The visualization must reflect authoritative water-system state.
A player action must produce a real state transition through the existing system.
Do not let the player visually connect arbitrary pipes to bypass repair conditions.
Do not report restored supply until the engineering system confirms it.
Do not introduce a new water simulation engine if the existing state model can represent the required behavior.

restorationWorkflow.description: Restore the main water supply only after the actual identified fault has been addressed and the supported verification test succeeds.

requiredStages.title: Inspect Water System
requiredStages.completionCondition: Actual main supply and distribution status retrieved.

requiredStages.title: Identify Water-System Fault
requiredStages.completionCondition: A fault is identified from existing persisted state or a supported diagnostic.

requiredStages.title: Verify Main Supply
requiredStages.completionCondition: Engineering system reports restored supply and a successful verification test.

sharedWaterSystemState.description: A single authoritative water-system state must be shared between Engineering, Habitat and the Research Zone.
rules: Engineering controls the main water supply state.
Habitat displays the relevant available water and nutrient information.
Cultivation Management displays the supply available to each rack.
A main supply restoration must update dependent displays through the existing state/event mechanism.
Individual rack irrigation faults remain independently diagnosable.
Rack 01 state must never overwrite Rack 02 state.
Do not create separate conflicting copies of the same water reserve value.

seedStorageInspection.description: Review existing seed storage information if the project already persists it.

tasks.title: Inspect Habitat Water and Nutrient Reserves
tasks.objective: Use the existing Habitat water and nutrients interface to inspect the current reserve information and record any reported shortage.
tasks.completionCondition: Habitat reserve information has been retrieved and inspection evidence persisted.

tasks.title: Review the Cultivation Experiment
tasks.objective: Open the existing cultivation display and review the SOL 6 experiment history, sample provenance and available observations.
tasks.completionCondition: Original SOL 6 cultivation records have been reviewed without modifying their provenance.

tasks.title: Inspect Cultivation Rack 01
tasks.objective: Inspect Rack 01 plant condition, irrigation status, nutrient supply and automation state.

tasks.title: Inspect Cultivation Rack 02
tasks.objective: Inspect Rack 02 independently using its own data binding.

tasks.title: Diagnose the Main Water Supply
tasks.objective: Use the existing Engineering Board and Supply OS application to inspect the main water supply and distribution system.
tasks.completionCondition: A supported diagnostic result has been persisted.

tasks.title: Restore the Main Water Supply
tasks.objective: Perform the required engineering repair using the existing water-system controls and verify the restored supply.
tasks.completionCondition: SOL09_MAIN_WATER_SUPPLY_RESTORED event is validated and persisted.

tasks.title: Verify Cultivation Irrigation
tasks.objective: Test irrigation delivery for both racks independently and resolve any supported irrigation fault.
tasks.completionCondition: Both rack verification events are validated and persisted.

tasks.title: Verify Nutrient Distribution
tasks.objective: Inspect nutrient availability and verify the existing nutrient distribution system using supported measurements and controls.
tasks.completionCondition: Nutrient system verification is persisted, or the report records that the relevant measurement or control is unavailable.

tasks.title: Review Cultivation and Water-System Evidence
tasks.objective: Review the recorded experiment, water-system repair result, rack conditions and irrigation verification results.
tasks.completionCondition: Evidence review is completed and the final assessment is saved.

tasks.title: Submit the SOL 9 Report
tasks.objective: Submit a report summarising the water-system condition, repairs, rack inspections, nutrient verification and cultivation experiment status.
tasks.completionCondition: All mandatory mission tasks are validated and the final report is persisted.

objectives.title: Inspect Habitat Water Reserves
objectives.completionCondition: Habitat water and nutrient information retrieved.

objectives.title: Review SOL 6 Cultivation Records
objectives.completionCondition: Existing cultivation history and sample provenance reviewed.

objectives.title: Verify Both Irrigation Systems
objectives.completionCondition: Rack 01 and Rack 02 irrigation verification events validated.

objectives.title: Verify Nutrient Distribution
objectives.completionCondition: Nutrient verification completed or explicitly recorded as unavailable.

destinations.description: Existing Habitat water and nutrients display.
Existing display connected to the two cultivation racks.
Existing Engineering Board and Supply display.

report.title: Water System Recovery & Cultivation Assessment
scientificReportingRules: Use persisted observations and validated mission events.
Do not fabricate plant growth, plant health, nutrient levels, water reserves or storm duration.
Do not alter SOL 6 sample identity or provenance.
Distinguish simulated gameplay telemetry from NASA-derived information.
Preserve unresolved issues in the final report.

dataProvenance.NASAData: Only explicitly sourced NASA datasets and records.
dataProvenance.MissionSimulation: PHOBOSIA gameplay state, simulated telemetry and mission events.
dataProvenance.CultivationExperiment: Persisted SOL 6 experiment records and later verified observations.
dataProvenance.StormHistory: Persisted SOL 7 timestamps and assessment records.
dataProvenance.unknownData: Must be labelled unavailable or not recorded.
